persona.label: Warehouse Manager
persona.frequency: all day, only module — daily queue work (component approvals, shadow-use reconciliation, stock levels)

goals: Clear the Component Request queue (approve/reject/ship) fast enough that SEs are not stuck WAITING_COMPONENT
Reconcile the Shadow Use Queue (RECONCILED/DISPUTED) so van-stock and audit trail stay accurate
Keep Zone Warehouse stock levels visible enough to reorder from Mother Warehouse before SEs get Hard-Filtered out of Day Plans
scopeNote: Component-Blocked Queue is a Zonal Manager read-only view (fed by the same Component Requests WM actions) — same module, two role-scoped surfaces, not a duplicate capability. SE Van Stock/Common Kit mobile screen is in-module (CLAUDE.md vertical-slice rule) but owned by the SE role, not the WM persona — captured below as role-sourced caps, not folded into WM's 3 goals.

capabilities.name: Component Request queue (Ticket context, SE identity, requested part, destination)
capabilities.why: WM cannot approve/reject/ship without this context; without it the queue cannot function at all

capabilities.name: Approve / Reject / Mark Shipped with tracking detail
capabilities.why: core daily action; without it every WAITING_COMPONENT ticket stalls indefinitely and SLA pause never lifts

capabilities.name: Shadow Use Queue with Reconcile / Dispute actions
capabilities.why: unreconciled SHADOW_USE rows corrupt van-stock counts and break the inventory audit trail (STOCK = dangerous territory)

capabilities.name: Escalate Disputed shadow-use row to Zonal Manager with reason
capabilities.why: without escalation, genuine fraud/coordination failures (two SEs same ticket) have no resolution path above WM

capabilities.name: Zone Warehouse stock levels per component
capabilities.why: only signal telling WM what to reorder from Mother Warehouse before Hard Filter grounds SEs for missing expected_component

capabilities.name: GPS serial / SIM serial verification against Ticket record
capabilities.why: without it WM cannot verify component usage claims on Install Tickets, opening a fraud/leakage gap

capabilities.name: Inventory rollback on failed GPS verification
capabilities.why: van stock stays wrong (overstated consumption) after a failed-verification ticket if not rolled back

capabilities.name: 7-day auto-escalation of stale Component Requests to ZM Action Required
capabilities.why: without it a WAITING_COMPONENT ticket can sit past SLA with no visibility above WM, silently breaching Fleet Uptime target

capabilities.name: Recovery Ticket RECEIVED_AT_WAREHOUSE confirmation
capabilities.why: only WM action that auto-closes a Recovery Ticket and logs the recovered asset back into inventory — otherwise ticket and asset both hang open

capabilities.name: SE Van Stock / Common Kit completeness view (mobile)
capabilities.why: SE is Hard-Filtered out of scheduling on incomplete Common Kit; without visibility SE cannot self-correct before being silently dropped from Day Plans

capabilities.name: Common Kit low/missing stock notification (mobile)
capabilities.why: proactive warning lets SE detour to Zone Warehouse before a mid-shift Hard-Filter grounding, vs. discovering it only when work stops
